Up to 4,000 families reportedly lost their homes, and one person died of a heart attack after a fire swept through a residential area in Barangay Pinyahan, Quezon City, Friday night into early Saturday morning.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place in view of “PINKATHON INDIA-2026” at JLN Stadium on 08.03.2026 (Sunday).

-Traffic movement will be regulated/diverted on certain stretches in South Delhi and commuters may experience congestion near Lodhi Road and surrounding areas.

Time: 03:00 AM – 09:30 AM

📍 Traffic diversions will be in place at JLN Gate No.17, Mehar Chand Market Signal, Kotla Red Light, 2nd Avenue–Jor Bagh Crossing & 4th Avenue–Jor Bagh Crossing.

📍 Commuters are advised to plan their journey in advance, avoid affected stretches around JLN Stadium and use alternate routes/public transport wherever possible.

📍Stay updated through Delhi Police Traffic channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

Patuloy ang waste collection ng Department of Sanitation and Cleanup Works of Quezon City (DSQC) upang mapanatili ang kalinisan sa evacuation centers kung saan nanunuluyan ang mga biktima ng sunog sa NIA Road, Brgy. Pinyahan. 

Nag-deploy din ang QC Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (QCDRRMO) ng mobile showers sa NIA Building at Manila Seedling para magamit ng evacuees.
